unresolved_by_construction: Python imports, Git object/ref access, subprocess reads and external services are not observed by this explicit file-reader receipt.

Runtime imports, plugin entry-point execution, Git/subprocess reads, and external services are not observed; the connector count is a static source declaration, not proof of installed or operational connectors.
JSON, TOML, and Python AST readers consume only the structures and fields named by this inventory; unselected document semantics are not validated here.
